question: What distinguishes fearless acceptance from hesitant refusal in this initiation context?
premises: Taking without hesitation leads to belonging to the Shakti lineage.
Such a person becomes freed from maya.
Trembling refusal leaves one as a samaya initiate limited to recitation and similar acts.
inference: Fearless acceptance marks a deeper initiation into the Shakti lineage, while hesitant refusal keeps the person at the samaya level.
plain_english: If he takes it without hesitation, he becomes one of the Shakti lineage and freed from maya; but if he trembles and does not take it, he remains a samaya initiate, limited to recitation and similar practices.
